entry.idea: barq is a digital wallet app that lets people send money abroad, hold a Visa card with no annual or international fees, and make cross-border payments, all licensed by Saudi Arabia's central bank.
entry.lesson: A well-connected founder with experience running a similar product can launch and scale a licensed financial app unusually fast.
entry.name: barq

growth.reason: It reached 15 million users and processed over $117 billion in transactions within two years of launch, very fast growth backed by numbers.

market.reason: Digital payments and money transfer are a large, essential need worldwide, though barq's licensed operations are anchored in Saudi Arabia.

tech.reason: It offers a standard e-wallet, card and cross-border payment stack, solid engineering but similar to many digital wallets globally, plus a partnership with Alipay+ rather than owned cross-border tech.

New fintech Barq led by former STC Pay CEO launches in Saudi Arabia
Barq, a digital wallet by the former Stc Pay CEO, hits 1 million users in just three weeks
Saudi fintech barq becomes Kingdom's newest unicorn after $329.5m funding round

entry.twist: It launched under a founder who previously ran a major Saudi digital wallet, and grew to 15 million users within two years by partnering with Alipay+ to let its users pay at merchants in more than 220 countries.
entry.who_pays: Everyday users pay fees on money transfers and card use, and the company also earns from its growing transaction volume across its financial products.
entry.why_now: More people want to send money abroad and pay across borders digitally, and new central bank e-wallet licenses in Saudi Arabia made it possible to launch a full digital wallet quickly.

mentions.snippet: Licensed digital financial services; founded 2023; $329.5M Series A at a $1.85B valuation.
